## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry cap should be reduced to five to satisfy the governing project policy. A persistently failing upstream currently receives ten calls with the default settings.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When an upstream consistently raises `OSError`, the default makes ten attempts, exceeding the required five-attempt cap. `AGENTS.md:5` states, “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Reduce the default and accepted maximum to five, and align the tests and documentation. — Failing upstreams receive twice the permitted attempts, increasing load and delaying error propagation.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Added tests exercise recovery after transient failures, retry exhaustion, and the absence of sleep after a single failed attempt.
